name: Jiuquan SLC-43
tagline: China's crewed-spaceflight pad — every Shenzhou crew
description: The first Chinese space launch site (1958), operational orbital launches since 1970, and from 1999 onward the dedicated home of human spaceflight: every Shenzhou crew (1 through 19 as of 2025) has lifted from SLC-43 Pad 91 on Long March 2F rockets. Jiuquan is inland in the Gobi desert at 40.96°N — too far north for the equatorial geometry that Wenchang handles. Tianzhou cargo missions to Tiangong fly from Wenchang Space Launch Site instead.
best_known_for: China's crewed-spaceflight pad — every Shenzhou crew
